    - text: Tell Meta AI what you need, your budget, and the details that matter. It can narrow the choices, compare products, and help you decide what fits.

    - heading "Find the best spots around you" [level=2]
    - text: Get recommendations shaped around where you are, what you like, and who you are with. Ask for dinner, a day out, or a last-minute plan and refine the options together.
    - button "Get local recommendations"
    - text: Find highly rated coffee shops near me with a relaxed atmosphere A vibrant hub for local coffee, featuring a high density of specialty shops within just a few blocks. Whether you want a minimalist space or a cozy corner, you will find several top-rated options here. Most spots are highly walkable, making it easy to find your favorite roast and a great atmosphere!
    - img "Map of nearby coffee shops recommended by Meta AI"
    - heading "Go deeper with research" [level=2]
    - text: Ask a complex question and Meta AI can search across sources, organize the findings, and turn them into a cited report. Compare options, understand a new topic, or plan a project without juggling tabs.
    - button "Start deep research"
    - text: "I'm looking for preschool programs for my 2-year-old. Create a research report to help me understand my options. Include timelines and pros and cons. Show thinking For a 2-year-old, the choice comes down to fit more than ranking. I looked at current research and national quality standards to build a simple way to evaluate local programs. The report breaks down pros and cons with evidence, what to actually look for on tours, and a 5-step decision framework plus a shortlist strategy for applications. Early Childhood Education: Choosing a Program for a 2-Year-Old Overview For a 2-year-old, the choice comes down to fit more than ranking. This guide compares five common program styles you will see on tours, looks at what research says about how toddlers learn, and gives a simple way to evaluate any local option."
    - heading "Stay connected to your business" [level=2]
    - text: Use Meta AI to work through customer questions, content ideas, and everyday planning. Keep the conversation grounded in your goals so the next step is easier to see.
    - button "Get help with your business"
    - text: What types of content have worked best for me over the last month for my Instagram account?     - text: Draft captions for posts, Reels and Stories, a bio that sounds like you, and a content plan so you are not starting from a blank box every morning.

limitations: Event sequence records provider receipt order; simultaneous browser causality is not inferred.
Network content is retained only when selected; Playwright response-body bytes are API results and are not guaranteed to match wire bytes.
Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and the observer does not request bodies from unfinished responses.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
